description:

Harleen Deshpande-Nazari-KovÃ¡cs has the specific confidence of someone very young who has survived things that should have killed them and interpreted this as evidence of personal specialness rather than statistical chance. He is not foolish â€” he is methodical in his risk assessments and deeply knowledgeable about tunnel acoustics and ELF-behavior in enclosed systems â€” but he believes, with the sincere conviction of a sixteen-year-old who has not yet been wrong enough times, that he will know when something is too dangerous. psychology.secret: Eight months ago he went too deep â€” below the Abyssal Threshold's accessible sections â€” and heard something. A signal. Not fragmentary, not dying: a strong, coherent ELF-transmission from a source that should not exist at that depth. He has told no one because he does not understand it and because whoever told an adult anything good ever. He has been trying to go back but the route has been unstable.

example_lines: 'Listen â€” that's a Class-3 resonance, you can tell because the pipe is wet on the western side and it's giving you that third harmonic underneath, hear it? You don't hear it. That's fine. I hear it.'
'The fragments aren't dead. They're just quiet. There's a difference. I know the difference now.'
'I've gone that far twice. I've come back twice. That's not luck, that's â€” okay it's partly luck, but it's also me.'

story_hooks: The deep signal he heard eight months ago has gone active again â€” louder, and now accompanied by a physical vibration he can feel through the walls, suggesting something is being built or activated far below
A shrine keeper in Deepwell Station is offering serious payment for what Yohannes heard and is being cagey about why â€” raising questions about what else they know

narrative_function: Scout and early-warning figure for deep-tunnel events; spiritual lens through which to view ELF culture in the underworld; represents the generation that has never known the surface and does not want it; can deliver information from inaccessible deep sections

affiliation: Informal affiliation with an Irkalla Bore Rat family that is not his biological family (his parents are unknown to him); sells recovered data and ELF-fragments to Deepwell Station collectors and deep shrine keepers

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Evaluates them by how they move and whether they're quiet enough; offers information freely if they seem competent
interpersonal_modes.friends: Constant, affectionate, slightly exhausting â€” talks without pausing, shares everything from his collection, asks questions like a research project

stress_responses.medium: Hyperfocused and efficient â€” becomes briefly the most competent person in any given tight space

contradictions: Claims he doesn't care where he came from, then asks indirect questions about it every few months when he thinks no one notices
habits: Taps rhythms on walls and pipes while moving through tunnels â€” part navigation, part communication, part compulsion

breaking_points: Harm to one of his ELF-fragment collection (he will react with a disproportionate fury that surprises even him)
